title: Felipe Contreras, in the Stanford ETL audience while building his own startup — 'Incredible talk by Eric Ries at Stanford University'
summary: A brand strategist attending the Entrepreneurial Thought Leaders session writes it up from a founder's seat, crediting Lean Startup with retiring the business-plan class and noting the new book was the subject of the evening.
blockquote: Incredible talk by Eric Ries at Stanford University. Eric, author of The Lean Startup (2011), is one of the people who changed how business schools teach entrepreneurship and startups.
